name: Leipzig Corpora Collection zho_news_2020_10K

licence.name: CC BY (per Leipzig terms of usage for downloadable corpora)
licence.method: The live terms page could not be fetched directly (anti-bot interstitial), so the Internet Archive snapshot 20260206070156 of that page was used. It states that the text corpora offered for download are made available under CC BY; the CC BY-NC clause on the same page applies to the web applications, not the downloads.

used_for: evaluation only: source of the derived hash-split dev/test corpora (scripts/build_eval_corpus.py). Its sentences are excluded exactly from n-gram training (scripts/build_bigrams.py --exclude), but it is a sample of the same news-2020 collection as two training files, so near-duplicate leakage is possible; the source-separated test set (zho-cn_web_2015_30K) exists to measure without that risk.
redistribution: No. Fetched on demand; the derived TSVs (Tests/Corpus/derived-*.tsv) contain corpus text and are therefore gitignored, regenerable with the recorded seed.
citation: D. Goldhahn, T. Eckart and U. Quasthoff: Building Large Monolingual Dictionaries at the Leipzig Corpora Collection. LREC 2012.
